rules.source: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024 — https://cipit.org/?p=3121
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: adopted by Parliament 4 April 2024, in force 24 July 2024 (per Digital Policy Alert); establishes the Ethiopian Communications Authority as supervisory authority; requires local storage of locally collected personal data and restricts transfers to countries without adequate protection.
Search summary: controllers must document personal data breaches and communicate them to data subjects within 72 hours unless certain conditions are met.
Council of Europe Octopus page (search summary): Proclamation 958/2016 entered into force 7 July 2016, with substantive offences (including illegal content data) and procedural powers.

rules.source: Hate Speech and Disinformation Prevention and Suppression Proclamation No. 1185/2020 — https://www.article19.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Hate-Speech-and-Disinformation-Prevention-and-Suppression-Proclamation.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: defines and prohibits hate speech and disinformation (false information with high likelihood of public disturbance); platforms must act on flagged material (one summary: removal within 24 hours of notification); overseen by the Ethiopian Broadcast Authority.
